messages:
maria: Heads-up: kicking off a config-only push for traffic-split + tiny batch/window changes. will pin model v2.3.1 on canary tenants and split traffic 5/95 for 30m. deploying at 18:15 UTC.
raj: ack. which routes are affected?
maria: only /generate and /chat routes; routing policy updated to prefer low-latency pool, ttl timeout 60s -> 45s, queue_limit 120 -> 80, batching window 8ms -> 6ms.
olga: will the kv-cache warmers be disabled during canary?
maria: yes, kv warmers set to passive for canary to avoid cross-tenant cache contamination.
deploy-bot: deploy started by @maria at 1717604340. stages: canary(5%) -> ramp (25%) -> full. expected hold at canary for 30m.
sre-oncall: watching latency and error rates on dashboard. put an alert for tail latency > 300ms or 5xx spike > 0.5%.
raj: also add a short-circuit fallback rule: if canary 5xx rate > 0.3% for 5m -> immediate rollback to v2.3.0 for pinned tenants.
maria: done, added rollback gating in rollout policy. also note: tenant floor and reserved capacity unaffected.
olga: quick note: batching window change may decrease throughput slightly for large sequences; ops should be ready to bump concurrency if we see queue uptick.
deploy-bot: canary reached 5% at 1717604350. monitoring metrics: p50 latency +4ms, p95 +12ms, 5xx 0.02%.
maria: initial looks good. holding until 18:45 UTC. please post any anomalies here. :eyes:
raj: if we see kvcache pressure, plan is to revert batching window and re-enable passive prewarm. manual rollback if needed.
sre-oncall: seeing a small uptick in CPU for low-latency pool but within expected; tracking.
olga: +1 on manual rollback plan. if we need to unwind sticky routing, will we clear tenant pins or shift them back?
maria: unwind plan: unpin tenants -> route back to global pool gradually; deploy-bot will automate unpin after rollback.
deploy-bot: note: automated unpin will wait 2m after rollback to avoid oscillation.
sre-oncall: FYI added lightweight dashboard snapshot and a perf log capture for a few anomalous requests.
maria: thanks. assume ramp to 25% at 18:50 if no issues. posting release note in #release-notes after full ramp.aj: one more: limit softcap set to 750 req/min per tenant temporarily — keep eyes on throttles.
maria: acknowledged. calling this thread open for the hold period. ping me if you want to trigger rollback. :thumbsup:
